verdict.rationale: SendGrid's own docs show it offers dynamic transactional templates, with multiple versions per template. However, nothing in the pack describes the templating syntax, merge fields, conditionals or loops, or any preview or test-render feature. Sandbox mode only validates a Mail Send request without delivering it, which is a dry-run check rather than a template render preview, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented templating language (merge fields, conditionals, loops), template preview/test-render capability, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending

citations.quote: Twilio SendGrid allows multiple versions of a dynamic template. Each version might offer different content on the same theme.
With features like dynamic templates, real-time validation, deliverability insights, and advanced analytics
